title: Calendar
subtitle: Medications, appointments, and tasks in one place.

empty.hint: Add a medication or appointment to start tracking care here.
empty.hintReadOnly: When the care team adds medications or appointments, they'll show up here.

errorHint: Check your connection and try again.
selectDayHint: Select a day to see its events

errors.permissionDenied: You don't have permission to make changes in this circle.
errors.saveFailed: Couldn't save your changes. Please try again.
errors.doseAlreadyLogged: This dose was already logged — its time can't be changed.
errors.invalidOccurrenceDate: This event no longer repeats on that day — the calendar has been refreshed.

schedulePresets.label: Common schedules
schedulePresets.threeTimesDaily: Three times daily (8:00 AM, 2:00 PM, 8:00 PM)

hints.timeOptional: Leave blank for an all-day event.

reminders.enableHint: Controls every notification for this entry.
reminders.atTimeHint: The main alert, sent when it's due.
reminders.atTimeOff: Nothing will be sent at the scheduled time — only the earlier reminders you pick below.
reminders.atTimeOffNoEarlier: No reminder will be sent before this dose — the first alert would be the missed-dose follow-up, 15 minutes after it was due.
reminders.escalation: If a dose isn't confirmed, we follow up: the care recipient after 15 minutes, caregivers after 30, the whole circle after an hour.
reminders.escalationSelf: If a dose isn't confirmed, we follow up: you after 15 minutes, caregivers after 30, the whole circle after an hour.
reminders.offMedication: No one will be notified when this dose is due, and no one will be alerted if it's missed.
reminders.offGeneric: No one will be reminded about this — not you, and not anyone else in the circle.
reminders.noneSelected: Select at least one time, or no reminder will be sent.
reminders.webDelivery: Reminders are delivered to the CircleCare mobile app.

howItWorks.title: How notifications work
howItWorks.scheduledBody: A notification is sent at the scheduled time, to the CircleCare mobile app.
howItWorks.earlyBody: Optionally get reminded 24 hours, 1 hour, 30 minutes, or 15 minutes before the scheduled time.

validation.endTimeAfterStart: End time must be after the start time.

validation.locationTooLong: Location must be 250 characters or fewer.
validation.descriptionTooLong: Details must be 850 characters or fewer.

alerts.pastTimeEditMessage: This time has already passed today — no reminder will be sent for today's dose.

deleteEvent.title: Delete event
deleteEvent.recurringMessage: "{{title}}" repeats. Choose what to delete — this can't be undone.

discontinueMed.title: Discontinue medication
discontinueMed.confirmMessage: Discontinue "{{title}}"? This stops the whole medication now — all upcoming doses leave the calendar and it moves to Inactive. Past history is kept. You can reactivate it anytime.
discontinueMed.inactiveCalendarNote: This medication is inactive. Doses from before it was discontinued stay on the calendar, and you can still mark one taken or skipped — a dose that was really given should be recorded. Reactivate the medication to change its details or resume reminders.
discontinueMed.editInactiveMessage: This medication is inactive. Reactivate it to make changes.
